blocks.x: What Process & Task Mining means at Achala IT Solutions: the scope we sign, the architecture we ship, the evidence generated in-flight, and the per workflow outcomes measured against your audited baseline.
The short version of Process & Task Mining: named metrics, named owners, evidence that travels. The sections below walk through the pattern, the components and the commitments.

blocks.title: Agent fleet orchestration loop — Process & Task Mining
blocks.note: The orchestration layer owns sequencing and recovery; the workers own their single tasks; the ledger owns the truth about what happened.

blocks.x: Process & Task Mining runs on a structure your control owners can interrogate — the decision plane, the evidence plane and the governance plane stay separate in design and reconciled in operation.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Process & Task Mining capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

items: Duplicated work
One registry, one contract per capability — the second team building the same connector gets introduced to the first.
Agent sprawl
Every agent ships with a scoped task, an owner and a budget — sprawl treated as a design smell, not a growth stage.
Runaway loops
Agent loops budgeted and capped — a runaway worker stops at the wallet, not at the incident review.
